name: code-server
author: coder
description: Full VS Code, integrated terminal included, in any browser on the tailnet — the way to work on this box from a phone or a borrowed laptop. A systemd user unit with auth disabled, because the tailnet is the access-control layer. It owns / on :443, which is why the launcher hangs off /home/ instead; its state lives in ~/.config/code-server rather than ~/services.
